title: Burst sideways like a sheep in clover
html_source:
Acidosis, a condition where grains or starches are overconsumed and so cannot be digested, and so ferment in the gut, causing many problems, including swelling.

https://www.agric.wa.gov.au/feeding-nutrition/grain-overload-acidosis-or-grain-poisoning-stock#:~:text=Grain%20overload%20is%20also%20known,is%20required%20for%20severe%20cases.

Part of a series of Bloom’s observations about swollen bellies and gas, to continue in the next few lines.

To me, this might be an oblique reference to the hazy, insubstantial unreality of the underworld.
